name: SquadPy
author: noreply@example.com
description: Installs and runs SquadPy (Python framework for Squad server management).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
  echo "GIT_ADDRESS is required."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
  export GIT_USERNAME="${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}"
  cat > /tmp/git-askpass.sh <<'ASKPASS'
#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in
  *Username*) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_USERNAME}" ;;
  *Password*) printf '%s\n' "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ;;
  *) printf '\n' ;;
esac
ASKPASS
  chmod 700 /tmp/git-askpass.sh
  export GIT_ASKPASS=/tmp/git-askpass.sh
  echo "Using token-based git authentication."
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
  echo "Existing git repository detected. Pulling latest branch state."
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
  git checkout -B "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" FETCH_HEAD
else
  rm -rf /mnt/server/*
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /mnt/server
fi

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
pip install -e .

mkdir -p config config/plugins logs data .pterodactyl

cp -n config/logging.toml.example config/logging.toml || true
cp -n config/database.toml.example config/database.toml || true

for plugin in auto_kick_unassigned admin_request discord_chat_bridge plugin_manager server_status tk_warn; do
  if [[ -f "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml.example" ]]; then
    cp -n "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml.example" "config/plugins/${plugin}.toml" || true
  fi
done

cat > /mnt/server/.pterodactyl/startup.sh <<'STARTUP'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container
mkdir -p config config/plugins logs data

autogen="${AUTO_GENERATE_SERVER_TOML:-true}"
autogen="${autogen,,}"

if [[ "$autogen" == "1" || "$autogen" == "true" || "$autogen" == "yes" || "$autogen" == "on" ]]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path


def env_bool(name: str, default: str) -> bool:
    return os.getenv(name, default).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
    raw = os.getenv(name, str(default)).strip()
    try:
        return int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        return default


def env_float(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    raw = os.getenv(name, str(default)).strip()
    try:
        return float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        return default


def env_str(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return os.getenv(name, default)


def toml_string(value: str) -> str:
    escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
    return f'"{escaped}"'


log_mode = env_str("LOG_MODE", "local").strip().lower()
if log_mode not in {"local", "sftp"}:
    log_mode = "local"

lines = [
    "[rcon]",
    f'host = {toml_string(env_str("RCON_HOST", "127.0.0.1"))}',
    f"port = {env_int('RCON_PORT', 21114)}",
    f'password = {toml_string(env_str("RCON_PASSWORD", "change_me"))}',
    "",
    "[log]",
    f"enabled = {'true' if env_bool('LOG_ENABLED', 'false') else 'false'}",
    f'mode = {toml_string(log_mode)}',
    f'path = {toml_string(env_str("LOG_PATH", "/home/container/SquadGame.log"))}',
    f"poll_interval = {env_float('LOG_POLL_INTERVAL', 0.25)}",
    "",
    "# SFTP settings (used when mode = \"sftp\")",
    f'host = {toml_string(env_str("LOG_SFTP_HOST", ""))}',
    f"port = {env_int('LOG_SFTP_PORT', 22)}",
    f'username = {toml_string(env_str("LOG_SFTP_USERNAME", ""))}',
    f'password = {toml_string(env_str("LOG_SFTP_PASSWORD", ""))}',
    "",
    "[discord]",
    f"enabled = {'true' if env_bool('DISCORD_ENABLED', 'false') else 'false'}",
    f'token = {toml_string(env_str("DISCORD_TOKEN", ""))}',
    f"guild_id = {env_int('DISCORD_GUILD_ID', 0)}",
    f'command_prefix = {toml_string(env_str("DISCORD_COMMAND_PREFIX", "!"))}',
    "",
]

Path("config/server.toml").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("Generated config/server.toml from panel variables.")
PY
fi

if [[ ! -f config/logging.toml && -f config/logging.toml.example ]]; then
  cp config/logging.toml.example config/logging.toml
fi

if [[ ! -f config/database.toml && -f config/database.toml.example ]]; then
  cp config/database.toml.example config/database.toml
fi

if [[ ! -d .venv ]]; then
  echo ".venv is missing. Reinstall the server first."
  exit 1
fi

source .venv/bin/activate
exec python -m squadpy
STARTUP

chmod +x /mnt/server/.pterodactyl/startup.sh

echo "Install complete. Set panel variables for Git/RCON/Discord and start the server."

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: SquadPy repository URL to clone during installation.

variables.description: Username used for private Git HTTPS auth (GitHub: x-access-token).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Optional token for private Git HTTPS auth. Leave empty for public repos.

variables.name: Auto Generate server.toml
variables.description: When true, writes config/server.toml from panel variables on every startup.

variables.name: Log Mode
variables.description: Log source mode: local file or sftp.

variables.name: Log Path
variables.description: Path to SquadGame.log (local mode) or remote path (sftp mode).
